summary: Six misses: two touch questions that did touch, two confident above-level calls that fell short of the level, one overconfident rules call and one absence-of-evidence call. No topic shows a new shared pattern, so no checklist items are proposed; neither confident miss lacked the latest price.

misses.note: The window had already run two days and the highs printed inside it on Nov 2-3 were never looked up, so the touch chance started from the current price alone.
A 40% touch estimate from distance and realised range was sound; the level printed anyway.
72% rested on drop-box and vote-centre watch reports while its own base rate was 1 in 4 and the rules may not count drop boxes.
Set 25% because no source showing a qualifying venue was opened; absence of evidence was treated as evidence of absence on a question with an empty title.
78% with a 4.3% cushion over three days was in line with the volatility estimate; the price fell through the level after the October inflation release.
77% from about 3% daily moves ignored fat tails after a 9% weekly drop and an unresolved inflation release the same morning; no count of past weeks was made.
